outcome: Incidence of congenital nasolacrimal duct obstruction (CNLDO)
Need for surgical intervention for CNLDO
cohort: 173 children under the age of 24 months diagnosed with CNLDO, epiphora, and dacryocystitis
finding: Cesarean section delivery was significantly associated with an increased incidence of CNLDO.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was significantly associated with an increased incidence of CNLDO.
gest_age: Lower in the cesarean section group (specific values not provided)
followup_time: Mean age at presentation was lower in the cesarean section group (9.4 +/- 6.8 months vs 12.07 +/- 8.8 months)
birth_weight: Lower in the cesarean section group (specific values not provided)
